signal: The company rebranded from Workrise back to RigUp in late 2025, recommitting to oil and gas as operators push for 40-60% supply-chain cost savings.

email.body1:
Matt, saw the company moved back to the RigUp name, recommitting to oil and gas as operators push for big supply-chain savings.

A relaunch and renewed focus usually mean more in-market accounts than the team can cover before everyone ramps on the message, and that is where pipeline cools. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for RigUp off hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress ~4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Matt, quick follow-up for RigUp.

With renewed demand in the sector, the target list usually outruns the team's capacity to work it. Most leaders don't know exactly how many meetings the team needs to book to hit the number, so the gap shows up late in the quarter.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings RigUp needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Matt, last bit of proof for RigUp.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how RigUp's reply rate likely compares to peer energy-tech teams. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?
email.body4:
Matt, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority while the relaunch settles, no problem at all. Rebrand quarters carry their own load.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your sales motion? I'll tailor it to RigUp either way.
